initiative.title: Coder: route each message to the right agent, and Microcoder for the rest
initiative.body: Every coding-agent issue lives here. The Lab's router (Mammoth) picks Claude Code, Codex or other for each message; other goes to Microcoder, a small Coax agent loop that runs on whichever model gateway fits, Google first. The old Rust inference upstreams move over as Coax gateways.

milestones.title: Gateways v1: Vertex, Gemini and OpenRouter
milestones.body: The gateway interface, streaming, Chat Completions, the three first gateways and fallback plans, tested on the recorded fixtures.

milestones.title: Microcoder v1 behind the Lab's other route
milestones.body: The loop, its tools and the Lab hookup, so a message Mammoth routes to other gets answered.

milestones.title: Gateways v2: the rest of the old upstreams
milestones.body: Z.ai, Vercel, OpenAI and Anthropic direct, psionic, Pylon, rates and the text-action fallback.

milestones.title: Ours: inference without the user's own keys
milestones.body: /v1/inference in coax/web/api, metered by account; the Mammoth key leaves the app.

tasks.title: Gateway interface, SSE reader and a streaming curl transport
tasks.body:
coax/lib/gateway/: GwRequest, GwEvent (text_delta, reasoning_delta, done, refused), GwUsage and the Gateway shape. An SSE line reader, and a streaming variant of coax/lib/systemone's curl transport that reads stdout as it comes. The key is read by curl from the environment, never passed through Coax or curl's arguments. From crates/inference/src/{event,sse,stream,request,response}.rs.

Spec: docs/coder/microcoder.md. The old code is at 0b401561a0^ (the commit before the Coder service was removed).
acceptance: Tests replay the recorded fixtures (0b401561a0^:crates/coder/fixtures/gateway/*.sse) into GwEvents
A streamed call delivers text deltas before the response ends
No key appears in arguments, logs or errors

Spec: docs/coder/microcoder.md. The old code is at 0b401561a0^ (the commit before the Coder service was removed).
acceptance: Request bodies match the old crate's for the same input
Streamed and whole responses both parse, including usage

tasks.title: Plans: fallback before the first token, benching on 401/402
tasks.body:
Up to three (gateway, model) attempts. Move on after a refusal or a failure before the first token, never after it. A 401 or 402 benches that gateway for the session. Each attempt is logged (gateway, model, status, latency, tokens), never the prompt. From crates/inference/src/router.rs and microcoder-loop failover.rs and capacity.rs.

Spec: docs/coder/microcoder.md. The old code is at 0b401561a0^ (the commit before the Coder service was removed).
acceptance: A refused first attempt falls through to the second
A failure after the first token ends the call instead of retrying
The attempt log never contains prompt text

tasks.title: Microcoder loop: state, one structured call a step, endings
tasks.body:
coax/lib/microcoder/: MicroState (environment, task, route, last 12 actions with output head and tail, viewed files, notes), the NextAction schema (rationale, commands, view, finished, reply, ask), and the endings finished, asked, bad_replies, no_capacity, stopped and idle. Microcoder imposes no step or time limits of its own.

Spec: docs/coder/microcoder.md. The old code is at 0b401561a0^ (the commit before the Coder service was removed).
acceptance: 'what is 2+2' finishes in one step with no commands
Three replies that fail the schema end the run as bad_replies
Tests run against a scripted gateway

tasks.title: Microcoder tools: commands and view
tasks.body:
Commands run in the working directory through coax/platform/process-native.c with a 30 s timeout and capped output; view reads files under the working directory, 64 KB each. With local_work under 0.5 commands are refused with a note in state.

Spec: docs/coder/microcoder.md. The old code is at 0b401561a0^ (the commit before the Coder service was removed).
acceptance: 'how many Swift files are in this folder' runs one command and answers
A command past its timeout is killed and recorded

tasks.title: The Lab's other route runs Microcoder
tasks.body:
In the Mac app, a Lab message Mammoth routes to other runs Microcoder. The routing JSON stays first, then one row per step (gateway, model, commands, exit codes, folded output), and the reply streams through the 120 ms push. harness_started becomes true. STOP ends the run.

Spec: docs/coder/microcoder.md. The old code is at 0b401561a0^ (the commit before the Coder service was removed).
acceptance: A Lab message routed to other gets an answer in the transcript
The reply streams token by token
STOP works mid-stream

tasks.body:

Spec: docs/coder/microcoder.md. The old code is at 0b401561a0^ (the commit before the Coder service was removed).
acceptance: A held-out set of labelled messages routes as labelled at least 90% of the time

tasks.title: Our /v1/inference route in coax/web/api
tasks.body:
Our keys in Secret Manager, metered by account, so the Mac app works without the user's own keys. The Mammoth key moves behind it too, out of the app. From crates/gateway (BYOK, public, rates). Bitcoin rails only for payment.

Spec: docs/coder/microcoder.md. The old code is at 0b401561a0^ (the commit before the Coder service was removed).
acceptance: A signed-in user's Lab message reaches Vertex through /v1/inference
The Mac app ships with no provider key in it
